Emaar appoints ALEC as main contractor for Business Bay tower

Staff Reporter · 27 July 2026

Emaar Development has appointed ALEC Engineering and Contracting as main contractor for a residential tower in Business Bay, Dubai, in a deal the developer said is worth AED 1.2 billion.

The 62-storey tower will comprise 640 apartments and is scheduled for handover in 2029. Enabling works are already complete and the contractor is expected to mobilise on site within weeks.

ALEC has delivered several projects for the developer, including retail and hospitality work across Dubai.
